title: シェアサイクル駐輪ドック
description: 歩道に設置するシェアサイクルのドック5基と操作端末です。低い床レール、ロック爪付きのドック柱と前輪当て、各ドックの状態表示灯、ひさし付きの端末柱、タッチ画面・カード読取部・無地の案内板を造形しています。自転車、事業者名やロゴ、画面表示、電気的な機能は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）4.370 × 1.890 × 0.470 m、3,688三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A five-dock bike-share station with a payment kiosk for sidewalk installation. It models the low ground rail, dock posts with lock-jaw housings and wheel bumpers, a status light on each dock, a canopied kiosk column, touch screen, card reader and a blank information panel. Bicycles, operator names or logos, on-screen content and electrical function are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 4.370 × 1.890 × 0.470 m; 3,688 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
